Symboli Rudolf seized a brilliant 1st 
place victory, her spirits soaring as she 
looked ahead to the Satsuki Sho. Watching 
her, the student council clerk felt an 
immense distance between them.

Afterward, she ran into the "Monster," 
Maruzensky. Like Symboli Rudolf, she was 
another Umamusume creating a buzz in the 
racing world with her extraordinary 
talent.

What kind of run would Symboli Rudolf show 
in a battle against Maruzensky? The 
Trainer let their thoughts drift to that 
distant future.
